name: Sumitomo Electric Industries, Ltd.
blurb: Sumitomo Electric Industries is one of Japan's largest diversified electrical manufacturers, with major businesses in wiring harnesses, power cables, electronics, and information and communications equipment — the last of which includes optical fibers, cables, optical devices, and telecommunications components. As one of the top global fiber-optic cable suppliers alongside Corning and Prysmian, Sumitomo benefits directly from hyperscaler spending on backbone and data-center interconnect cabling for AI infrastructure.
recent: Shares traded near JPY 9,900 in early May 2026, within a 52-week range of JPY 2,330–11,495, reflecting a sharp re-rating as fiber-cable demand accelerated. The ADR (SMTOY) traded near USD 62. Goldman Sachs, Nomura, UBS, and Jefferies all carried buy ratings in spring 2026, with a consensus 12-month target near JPY 11,896. The global fiber optic cable market is projected to grow from USD 14.2 billion in 2026 to USD 22.7 billion by 2031.
